entry.name: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
entry.note: Code-first: you train real models in lesson one and earn the theory afterward

covers: PyTorch, fastai, and Hugging Face libraries
reading.format: Video course with 9 lessons, each around 90 minutes long, recorded at the University of Queensland.
reading.summary: Practical Deep Learning for Coders is a free video course that teaches how to apply deep learning and machine learning to practical problems. It covers building and training models for computer vision, natural language processing, tabular analysis, and collaborative filtering, using PyTorch and the fastai library. By the end of the second lesson, students have built and deployed their own deep learning model. The course is based on the fastai book and is designed for people with some coding experience.
reading.audience: People with some coding experience who want to learn how to apply deep learning and machine learning to practical problems. It is designed to be accessible to people without a technical or mathematical background, though a technical background is also fine.
reading.prerequisites: Know how to code, preferably in Python, with about a year of experience, and have followed a high school math course. No special hardware, software, or university math is required.
